visual_language.medium: Documentary/editorial mixed media: 16mm/35mm-film and contact-sheet photography translated through matte print, graphite/grease-pencil annotation, collage, and restrained spot-color overprint on uncoated stock.
visual_language.surface: Visible film grain, paper fiber, halftone or contact-print texture, registration drift, tape/annotation traces, and matte ink remain legible; the deck should feel printed, handled, archived, and re-sequenced rather than digitally perfected.
visual_language.mark_making: Documentary photographic evidence is interrupted and connected by hand-drawn diagrams, arrows, grease-pencil circles, notebook marks, crop marks, repeated frames, and occasional rhythmic overprint; marks should feel investigatory or participatory rather than decorative.
visual_language.signature_accent: A restrained Byrne-like graphic accent vocabulary—signal red, optimistic yellow, sky blue, and occasional fluorescent stage color—appears as annotation, light, clothing, signage, or overprint against documentary neutrals.
visual_language.finish: Human-scale documentary modernism: intelligent, awkward, warm, materially analog, visually curious, and increasingly embodied across the deck; never a glossy celebrity portrait series or a generic music-poster house style.
avoid: uniform digital surfaces with no film or paper texture
nostalgia filters applied identically to every era
turning every card into a literal concert photograph
